description: This source file implements a Tuner class within the Thunder::Broadcast namespace, providing functionality for DVB frontend tuning, filtering, and status monitoring on Linux DVB devices. It includes methods for tuning parameters, filtering PSI/SI tables, and managing tuner state, along with internal classes for resource management and thread handling.

classes.name: Tuner
classes.description: Represents a DVB frontend tuner, providing methods for tuning, filtering, and status monitoring, with internal resource and thread management classes.

classes.name: Tuner::Observer
classes.description: Manages registration and notification of tuner instances, running in a separate thread.

classes.name: Tuner::MuxFilter
classes.description: Handles filtering of MPEG sections from DVB streams via Linux DVB demux device.

classes.name: Tuner::Information
classes.description: Singleton class storing tuner configuration, supported modes, and system type information.

methods.name: Tuner::Create
methods.description: Creates a new Tuner instance based on configuration string.

methods.name: Tuner::Tune
methods.description: Configures the tuner with specified frequency, modulation, symbol rate, FEC, and inversion.

methods.name: Tuner::Filter
methods.description: Sets up or removes a filter for a specific PID and table ID, with a callback for sections.

methods.name: Tuner::Properties
methods.description: Returns tuner properties such as support for auto FEC and second-generation support.

methods.name: Tuner::Id
methods.description: Returns a unique identifier for the current transport stream lock.

methods.name: Tuner::State
methods.description: Returns the current state of the tuner (IDLE, LOCKED, etc.).
